title: Loan File Stage Surcharge on Rate Lock Commitment Float-Downs
content:
**Float-down pricing by stage of the Mortgage Loan File (Rate Lock Commitment).** The later the file's stage, the higher the float-down surcharge. The surcharge is added to the float-down fee points, which are never below zero and are rounded to three decimal places.

**Rule.** When the loan file is clear to close, the cleared-file surcharge of **0.2** points is added. When it is conditionally approved, the approved-file surcharge of **0.1** points is added. Otherwise none is added.

| Loan file status | Surcharge (points) |
|---|---|
| Clear to close | 0.2 |
| Conditionally approved | 0.1 |
| Any other status (for example processing, underwriting or suspended) | 0 |

*Hypothetical case:* a borrower floating down on a conditionally approved file adds 0.1 points. Once the file is clear to close, 0.2 points.
